question:
Select the option that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e3ae8532ee67f4b5174b046c71b220aed9b2b8cce5a9be9944d2ccd5eb4936c.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1256a38e671e73d1817f146d4bfcb561bed4ca4da6f6fe81bab8ca6d7b47bdca.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

1. Symbols given on the outside corners of the pentagon are shifting clockwise start from left upper corner.

2.The symbol on the lower left corner is disappears in next step and a new symbol is appears at left upper corner in each step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a97f0d6392a9365b4cb014ffa9037dedb8c92d01ba788119a9cc4af8276e5e91.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (4)"**.
